## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m build`
- [ ] CPU behavior checked when relevant
- [ ] CUDA behavior checked when relevant, or marked not available

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed Python behavior.
- [ ] No model weights, user data, logs, or build artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] Dependency and model license implications were reviewed.
